hook: Dmitri Dolgov is co-CEO of Waymo, a post he has held since April 2021. He was one of the founders of Google's self-driving car project when it began in 2009, a project started by Sebastian Thrun, and ran its software as a Distinguished Software Engineer until it became Waymo in 2016, when he became chief technology officer. Before Google he was a senior research scientist at the Toyota Research Institute and a postdoctoral researcher on Stanford's DARPA Urban Challenge team.
